CustomField.description: How the HCP came to the event: Registered (imported registration, before the event), Walk-in - known HCP (already in Salesforce, not registered) or Walk-in - new HCP (created from the event capture).
CustomField.formula: IF( Registered__c, "Registered", IF( ISPICKVAL(Source_Capture__r.Matching_Status__c, "New HCP") || ISPICKVAL(Source_Capture__r.Matching_Status__c, "Reviewed - new HCP"), "Walk-in - new HCP", "Walk-in - known HCP" ) )
CustomField.label: Attendee Type
